title: De-identified FIA event-level aggregate (conditional public schema)
description: A release-scoped event-level summary shape. It contains no plot key, measurement control number, coordinate, geometry, or tree row. This schema is not permission to redistribute source-derived values.

x-openrec-eo.exact_fire_year: replace with fire_year_bin unless rights/privacy review explicitly permits exact year
x-openrec-eo.public_action: Hold until USDA FIA terms, external-product terms, author/institution licence, and disclosure review are closed.

release_event_id.description: Release-scoped identifier not derivable from Event_ID, plot keys, names, or coordinates.

fire_year_bin.description: Coarsened fire-year bin; exact year is not required for the aggregate contract.

coarse_region.description: Coarse region only; no state, coordinates, polygon, or event name.

n_fia_plot_pairs.description: Number of eligible plot pairs contributing to this event-level median.

median_log_ratio_basal_area_ft2_ac.description: Event median of plot-pair log response ratios for basal area (ft² ac⁻¹).

median_log_ratio_biomass_lb_ac.description: Event median of plot-pair log response ratios for biomass (lb ac⁻¹).

median_log_ratio_tree_density_ac.description: Event median of plot-pair log response ratios for tree density (ac⁻¹).

median_log_ratio_qmd_in.description: Event median of plot-pair log response ratios for quadratic mean diameter (in).

median_log_ratio_ba_weighted_height_ft.description: Event median of plot-pair log response ratios for basal-area-weighted height (ft).
